summary: Backend testing for the fraternity extension (chapters, tiers, awards, hours, photos, documents, file proxy, admin stats, public_user fraternity fields). 18 new pytest tests in test_fraternity.py — all pass after fixing one upload bug. Combined with existing suite: 41/41 backend tests pass. Object storage (emergent objstore) initialized successfully and round-trip upload/download/delete all work for PNG, plain text, and PDF.

minor.issue: Bug discovered & fixed: form fields title/album/category/description were declared as plain str defaults instead of Form(...). FastAPI treated them as query parameters, so multipart values were silently ignored — every photo got album='general', every document got category='general'. Fixed by importing Form and switching to Form('') / Form('general'). All upload tests now pass.

action_items: None blocking. Optional enhancement: GET /api/files/{path} currently has no auth — anyone with the storage path can fetch the file. If documents are meant to be members-only, gate this behind get_current_user.
Optional: list endpoints (chapters, tiers, awards, news, members, events) are public — confirm intentional, otherwise gate behind auth.
critical_code_review_comments: Upload bug (already fixed): without Form(...), FastAPI silently ignored multipart text fields. Same pattern should be audited for any other multipart endpoint added later.

GET /api/files/{storage_path} is unauthenticated — any logged-out visitor can pull a member document or photo by guessing/observing the storage path. If access control matters for documents, require auth and check ownership/role.
init_storage() result is cached in a module global (_storage_key) without a lock; not a problem under uvicorn's single event loop but worth noting for future workers.
Hours date validation: HoursLogIn.date is datetime but no upper-bound check (members could log future-dated hours). Consider rejecting future dates.
AssignTierIn.extend_days has no upper bound; admin could push membership_expires_at thousands of years out by typo.
/api/admin/stats fraternity.chapter_roster is computed by N+1 queries (one count_documents per chapter). Fine for <50 chapters; refactor to an aggregation if scale grows.
@app.on_event startup/shutdown still used (deprecated in modern FastAPI). Migrate to lifespan handler.
server.py is 1565 lines — split into routers (auth, members, events, fraternity, files) for maintainability.

rca of the issue: Upload form-field bug RCA: in FastAPI, parameters following an UploadFile parameter that are declared with a plain default (e.g. `title: str = ''`) are interpreted as QUERY parameters, NOT multipart form fields. Multipart text fields must be declared with `= Form(...)`. The frontend was sending album/category in form-data, but the backend silently used the defaults. Fix: `from fastapi import Form` and `title: str = Form('')`, `album: str = Form('general')`, etc. Verified by retesting test_photo_upload_list_delete and test_document_upload_list_delete_and_file_proxy — both pass after fix.
